themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in housing, healthcare, and social benefits. This theme remains dominant as parties like Vox in Spain, Fratelli d'Italia in Italy, and PiS in Poland push for legislative changes to enforce these priorities.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes laws to prioritize Spanish citizens in housing and social services, criticizing regional governments for failing to implement these policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for national priority in welfare and housing, aligning with Vox's stance in Spain.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Emphasizes national priority in social benefits and healthcare, resisting EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pushes for stricter immigration controls and national preference in social benefits.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Calls for British citizens to be prioritized in housing and healthcare, mirroring continental policies.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with Trump publicly criticizing Meloni for not supporting U.S. actions against Iran. This theme reflects broader transatlantic tensions and the fragility of right-wing alliances.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump escalates criticism of Meloni, accusing her of undermining U.S. interests and NATO unity.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni responds defensively, emphasizing Italy's sovereignty and strategic autonomy in foreign policy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Monitors the fallout, with figures like Bardella and Le Pen positioning themselves as potential mediators.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Supports Meloni's stance, framing the dispute as a defense of national sovereignty against U.S. pressure.

themes.title: Far-right leaders celebrate Colombia's election
themes.blurb: Far-right figures across the Americas and Europe have rallied behind Colombia's newly elected far-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella. This theme highlights the transnational celebration of right-wing electoral victories and the alignment of ideological agendas.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei congratulates de la Espriella, framing the victory as part of a broader Latin American shift toward libertarian and conservative policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump endorses de la Espriella, emphasizing shared anti-socialist and pro-security agendas.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal praises de la Espriella's victory, linking it to a rejection of 'narcosocialism' and leftist policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
